DVLoper Games Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy
Latest update: Apr, 2026
This privacy policy governs your use of the mobile games published by DVloper (DVapps AB).
Information We Collect
• Personal Information: We do not directly collect personal information such as your name, address, email, or contact details. However, our games may use third-party services that can collect data used to identify you, including device identifiers, approximate location (via IP address), and advertising information.
• Non-Personal Information: We may collect non-personal information about your device and usage, such as device type, operating system, language settings, and gameplay statistics, which helps us improve our services. We may also use cookies or similar technologies if you visit our official website.
• Automatically Collected Information: Our games use third-party advertising partners (including AppLovin, UnityAds, Admob, Meta and Ironsource) that may automatically collect data such as your device’s advertising ID, IP address, operating system, device model, and in-app behavior to provide analytics, serve ads, and personalize your experience.
Third-Party Services and Advertising
Our games integrate with third-party advertising partners to display ads and analyze usage. These providers may use your device identifiers and in-app activity for ad targeting and reporting purposes. Data collected by these partners is subject to their privacy policies:
•
UnityAds/Ironsource Privacy Policy
•
Admob/Google Privacy Policy
•
AppLovin Privacy Policy
•
Meta/Facebook Privacy Policy
•
Liftoff/ Vungle Privacy Policy
Privacy Rights and Choices for Users
• Do Not Sell My Personal Information: If you are a resident of California or certain other U.S. states, you may have the right to opt out of the “sale” or sharing of your personal data under privacy laws such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA). Our applications provide a “Do Not Sell My Personal Information” option in compliance with these laws. You can manage your preferences via our in-app privacy prompt.
• European Users (GDPR): If you reside in the European Union or a similar jurisdiction, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. Consent for data collection and ad personalization is collected via a privacy prompt within our app. You may change these choices at any time.
• Opt-out of Data Collection: You can stop all data collection by uninstalling the application. You may also adjust privacy settings using in-app prompts or through your device’s privacy controls.
Children’s Privacy
We do not knowingly collect or solicit personal data from children under the age of 16. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with information without your consent, please contact us.
Data Security
We take appropriate measures to protect your information. While we strive to safeguard your data, no system can be completely secure. Please use caution when sharing data online.
Changes to This Policy
We may update our privacy policy from time to time. Continued use of our apps means you accept the current privacy policy. Please review it periodically.
Contact Us
If you have any questions or requests regarding privacy, please contact us at
[email protected]
